data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter widget for selecting birth dates with auto-formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dedicated input widget for selecting birth dates with support for platform-specific pickers on iOS and Android. It handles auto-formatting of date fields, validation, localization, and direct keyboard input alongside a date picker icon button.
use_when: You need a specialized birth date input field with automatic formatting and validation.
You want platform-specific date pickers combined with direct keyboard entry.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose calendar or date range picker rather than a single birth date input.
strengths: Supports both iOS-style Cupertino and Android-style Material pickers.
Allows direct keyboard input with auto-formatting for year, month, and day.
weaknesses: Requires manual initialization of date formatting using intl package.
Limited to single birth date selection use-cases.
data.setup_notes: Initialize date formatting by calling initializeDateFormatting() in your main function before running the app.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need a full calendar view picker instead of a text-field based birth date input.
